data.cultural_impact: In Hindu culture, the name Subba holds a significant value as it is associated with purity, compassion, and kindness. The name is believed to denote someone who is good, benevolent, and virtuous. Subba is a popular name among the Tamil speaking communities in India, and it is also used as a temporal name for infants in certain Hindu rituals, signifying the hope for a good and compassionate future.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name Subba carries a deeper meaning and significance. The divine essence of this name resonates with the fundamental Hindu principles of Dharma, Artha, Kama, and Moksha (Duty, wealth, desire, and Liberation). Subba is believed to represent the pure and benevolent aspects of the soul that help an individual to fulfill Dharma (righteous duty) towards the Society and Moksha (liberation) for the Self.

name_in_real_life.story: Anita Subba, a teacher in Mumbai, India, shares that their name Subba meaning "Good, Benevolent" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Subba: One devoted to the service of God or Guru. Dedicated to the path of dharma and spiritual growth.
